heroHeadline: Ukraine Drones Strike Refinery 1,500 km Inside Russia; Russia Launches 116 Overnight; Cumulative Russian Losses ~1.353M
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,547, Ukrainian long-range drones struck another Russian oil refinery approximately 1,500 km (900 miles) deep inside Russia, igniting large fires — Zelensky confirmed the strike as Russia's MoD reported its defenses downed 121 inbound Ukrainian drones and 8 were injured in Belgorod Oblast. Overnight, Russia launched 116 Shahed drones against Ukraine; air defenses intercepted 109 (94%). On May 20, the Putin-Xi Beijing summit concluded with a sweeping 'multipolar world' joint declaration, Sino-Russian treaty renewal for 25 years, and progress on the Power of Siberia 2 gas pipeline — reinforcing the Russia-China strategic partnership even as Western pressure mounts. Zelensky warned that intelligence indicators suggest Russia may be preparing a new offensive toward the Chernihiv-Kyiv direction with potential Belarusian involvement. Russian cumulative losses reached ~1,352,980 personnel as of May 21 (+910 in 24 hours), with independent estimates (Economist, MIVD) now placing total Russian killed and wounded at 1.1–1.5 million.
footerNote: Data sourced from UN OHCHR, ISW, CSIS, Ukrainian MoD, US DoD, NATO, IAEA, EU Council, UK MoD, and major news outlets including Reuters, BBC, AP, Al Jazeera, Bloomberg, Kyiv Independent, Ukrinform, France 24, NPR, CNN, NBC News, PBS, The Moscow Times, CGTN, Newsweek, Yahoo News, Kyiv Post, Euromaidan Press, EMPR Media, CNBC, Semafor, and Euronews. Casualty figures are estimates; Russia has never released official figures.
